messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-4521: model-catalog-service error rate spike (5xx) x3 in last 60s. routing: catalog-promote-worker, region: us-west-2. link: https://pd.redwood/in/INC-4521
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert INC-4521 assigned to Maya (oncall)
Maya (oncall): ack. I'll take this. starting triage.
Maya (oncall): quick check — is this after the 02:00 catalog promotion?
Ashwin: yes, the auto-promo job pushed rev r2026-03-12-1430 to prod around 02:03. I was watching a low-traffic test and it succeeded.
Jen: customer-impact: support reported 3 customers seeing generation failures & 502s in the last 10m. ETA from them is now. No major revenue accounts yet but a few high-traffic clients affected.
Maya (oncall): copying playbook: https://redwood.internal/incident-playbooks/catalog-config-deviation. Steps: 1) identify bad revision, 2) route traffic to fallback variant, 3) rollback promotion.
Liam: I can check metrics. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/model-catalog/rcp. error-rate spikes line up w/ 02:04.
Riley: logs: ````
[2026-03-12T02:04:12Z] catalog-promote-worker: applied defaults: max_tokens=4096, tokenizer=sentencepiece-v2
[2026-03-12T02:04:13Z] catalog-promote-worker: pushed model rev r2026-03-12-1430 -> prod
[2026-03-12T02:04:15Z] serving: tokenizer init failed: unsupported-encoding
````

Ashwin: that "unsupported-encoding" screams tokenizer mismatch. The new revision has a tokenizer tag that runtime doesn't accept. I saw a packaging mismatch in the build logs earlier but thought it was isolated.

Maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause promotion job, 2) pin routing to previous revision r2026-03-10-2200 (fallback), 3) rollback catalog default config. Who can run the routing flip now?

Liam: I can flip LB routing for catalog variants. Command: ``kubectl patch svc catalog-router -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"revision":"r2026-03-10-2200"}}}'``. Will do after Ashwin confirms.

Ashwin: confirmed. Also prepare rollback command: ``python infra/tools/promote_model.py --env prod --model catalog --revision r2026-03-10-2200 --force``

Maya (oncall): go ahead Liam. Please comment when done. Also add a short message to support to advise customers.

Liam: done. `kubectl` patch applied. routing logs: ``[02:05:02] traffic-shift: 100% -> r2026-03-10-2200``

ops-bot: Traffic shift complete. health check OK. 0/3 5xx errors in last 60s for catalog endpoints.

Maya (oncall): nice. Ashwin, can you back out the catalog promotion job and start rollback?

Ashwin: initiating rollback. Running: ``python infra/tools/promote_model.py --env prod --model catalog --revision r2026-03-10-2200 --force``.

pagerduty: INC-4521 acknowledged by Maya (oncall). Status: Mitigating.

Jen: support update sent: "We've routed traffic to a stable model variant and are rolling back a recent catalog change. Some requests may have short failures; service is recovering."

Riley: quick note: we should check tokenization metadata for the broken revision. I suspect the tokenizer metadata field was mis-set to "sentencepiece-v2" while runtime expects "spm/v1".

Ashwin: logging into build artifacts now. found package metadata: tokenizer_tag: "sentencepiece-v2". We have a validation test that usually catches this but it was skipped in the fast-path promotion. Adding a temporary block.

Maya (oncall): good catch. Action items: Ashwin -> add validation block + patch promoter; Riley -> verify artifact tokenizer field and add regression test; Ops (Liam) -> keep routing pinned until next manual promote; Jen -> send customer follow-up in 15m.

Liam: leaving routing pinned. I'll monitor for 30m and watch autoscaler.

Ashwin: rollback finished. Catalog default set back to r2026-03-10-2200. Promotion job paused. Logs: ``[02:07:45] rollback complete; promoter paused``

ops-bot: Service health stable. Error rate returned to baseline. No active incidents.

Maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. We'll convert to postmortem ticket. Assigning to Ashwin & Riley. Please capture why validation skipped and how to fix the fast-path.

Jen: created ticket PM-7323: "Catalog promotion skipped tokenizer validation -> customer 502s" and linked to INC-4521. Notifying stakeholders.

Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. Handing off to postmortem owners. If anything else pops up, re-open INC-4521. I'll also do a short note in #incidents-summary. :white_check_mark:

Ashwin: brief note — we should probably add an automated check in the promoter: compare artifact tokenizer_tag to runtime-accepted list and fail promotion if mismatch. I'll PR in ~1h.

Riley: will add regression test and update promoter docs.

pagerduty: INC-4521 status changed to Resolved (mitigated).

Maya (oncall): last check: customer impact score: LOW->MED (some customers had retries but no data loss). Closing thread here.

Jen: posting customer follow-up now.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by Maya (oncall). Summary: catalog promotion created tokenizer mismatch causing 5xx; traffic routed to previous revision; promoter paused; postmortem opened PM-7323.
